name: Taburete bajo
adaptations: Original is solid white oak; written in T18 plywood
Round seat of about 330 mm drawn as a 330 x 330 square top with rounded corners
No measures from the seller: height 450 mm and diameter 330 mm estimated by proportion against the hand and the workbench in the photos; danish-oil as the closest finish id to oil or wax
It stacks in the piece (the legs open wider than the seat); stacking is not drawn
four open square legs with wedged through tenons drawn as four legs that lean outward and narrow to the foot, with an apron all round that the piece does not have
top overhangs the legs by 30 mm so that they can open and the corners can be rounded
Its top is the seat: the plan says the standing use, the one that gives a top the heavy load a seat is checked with.
notes: Banquito bajo de triplay. En Knotty queda con el asiento cuadrado de esquinas redondeadas (el original es redondo), que vuela 3 cm sobre cuatro patas abiertas que se adelgazan hacia el piso, unidas por un faldón bajo el asiento. No se apila.
